name: From AI Pilots to Business Impact: Closing the AI Usage Gap in 90 Days
description:
AI pilots are creating momentum, but many organizations still struggle to achieve measurable business outcomes.

Join our Executive Townhall to learn how leading organizations are accelerating AI adoption through workforce readiness, governance, and a practical 90-day framework that turns experimentation into lasting business impact.

**Date & Time**
📅 Thursday, Aug 31, 2026
🕛 12:00 PM EDT
⏱️ Duration: 60 Minutes

**Location**
Live on Microsoft Teams \| Executive Townhall
**[Register Now](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/adoptify-ai-townhall?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=microsoft_fy26_q3&utm_content=master_classes "https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/adoptify-ai-townhall?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=microsoft_fy26_q3&utm_content=master_classes")**

Reserve your seat today and join industry leaders to discover how to transform AI investments into measurable business results.

Despite significant investments in AI tools like Microsoft Copilot, many organizations face low adoption, fragmented usage, and unclear ROI. This executive discussion explores how leaders can overcome these challenges with structured adoption strategies, effective governance, and workforce enablement to drive enterprise-wide AI success.

**What You Will Learn:**

* Why AI pilots often fail to scale across the organization
* How to close the gap between AI access and workforce adoption
* Best practices for AI governance and change management
* A practical 90-day roadmap for driving measurable business impact
* Leadership strategies to accelerate enterprise AI adoption
* Call to Action

name: Human Judgment in the Frontier Era: Leading Work Beyond Prompt with Microsoft AI
description:
When AI can create, analyze, and execute work in seconds, the real advantage is knowing when to let AI lead, when to collaborate, and when human judgment must take over. Join our live masterclass to explore how professionals can work with Microsoft AI more intentionally while keeping quality, accountability, and critical decisions firmly in human hands.

📅 **Date:** Monday, September 14, 2026
🕙 **Time:** 10:00 AM EDT \| 07:30 PM IST \| 07:00 AM PDT
**[CLICK HERE TO REGISTER](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/microsoft-ai-human-judgment-frontier-era?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=microsoft_fy26_q3&utm_content=master_classes)**

**WHY JOIN?**
Learn how to move beyond basic prompting and develop a smarter approach to AI-enabled work. Discover how to delegate effectively, provide the right context, evaluate AI-generated results, and make confident decisions where human expertise matters most.

**AGENDA**

* Why prompt proficiency is only the starting point
* The four modes of AI-enabled work: asking, exploring, collaborating, and delegating
* Deciding what AI should execute and what humans must own
* Setting clear intent, context, constraints, and quality standards
* Redesigning a recurring business activity around human judgment and Microsoft 365 Copilot

**READY TO WORK SMARTER WITH AI?**
Join our live masterclass to discover how human judgment and Microsoft AI can work together to improve decisions, productivity, and everyday work.

**NOTE: ALL REGISTRATIONS WILL BE PROVIDED WITH DIGITAL ACHIEVEMENT BADGES ISSUED DIRECTLY FROM MICROSOFT.**

[REGISTER NOW AND SAVE YOUR SEAT.](https://www.netcomlearning.com/webinar/microsoft-ai-human-judgment-frontier-era?advid=1196&utm_source=meetup&utm_medium=event&utm_campaign=microsoft_fy26_q3&utm_content=master_classes)
